title: A tale of two tails and an off-centered envelope: diffuse light around the cD galaxy NGC 3311 in the Hydra I cluster

evidence.locator: Table 2 (Parameters for the 2D GALFIT fit models of NGC 3311), V band, VLT/FORS1, column 'allmask' (the north-east excess masked): total magnitude 10.1 +/- 0.01, effective radius 198.8 +/- 2.2 arcsec, n = 4.8 +/- 0.02, axis ratio 0.93, position angle 32 degrees. Column 'cmask': 270.6 +/- 3.4 arcsec, n = 5.0, position angle 38. Its note: the 2D model is fitted to the whole 6.8 x 6.4 arcmin area. Table 1, NGC 3309, 'allmask': effective radius 21.9 arcsec, n = 3.3, axis ratio 0.85. Sect. 4.2: an envelope off-centred to the north-east of NGC 3311 and tidal tails around HCC 026 and HCC 007.
